schnakenberg: du/dt = D_u laplacian(u) + gamma (a - u + u^2 v)
dv/dt = D_v laplacian(v) + gamma (b - u^2 v)
equations.critical_wavenumber: k_c^2 = (D_v f_u + D_u g_v) / (2 D_u D_v)
turing_conditions: (D_v f_u + D_u g_v)^2 > 4 D_u D_v det(J)

parameters_this_scale.note: gamma is the unique rate that places k_c at 2*pi/256 µm for these diffusivities. Not copied from a coarser sibling slot.

boundary_conditions: periodic square of side 3*lambda_c (768 µm). No-flux is not used; the primordium window is a periodic patch of the notch field.

reported_in_source: C. richardii gametophytes build a notch meristem whose archegonium sites depend on positional cues and cell-division dynamics (Geng, Yan & Zhou 2022; Bartz & Gola 2018).
The species is the standard homosporous fern model (Hickok, Warne & Fribourg 1995; Banks 1999; Plackett et al. 2014).
Two-component reaction-diffusion selects a finite critical wavenumber when the inhibitor diffuses farther than the activator (Turing 1952; Gierer & Meinhardt 1972; Schnakenberg 1979).
empirical_claims.not_reported: None of the cited papers measure a 256 µm Turing wavelength in Ceratopteris pigment. That length is the slot scale.

canonical_plate.role: Canonical fitness plate. Drawn 100 µm scale bar is 106 px.

anatomical_voucher.role: Transmitted-light gametophyte with notch meristem and dichotomous veins. Not the fitness crop.
